post.description: Read-only structured recall, no photos, generation job or AI call. Current session token required; does not refresh session TTL. No automatic request replay. HTTP route implementation is a separate backend increment.

200.description: 相关候选；空态和不足也返回200，数量如实报告

400.description: 请求非法、重复或无法解析的上下文ID；不静默忽略未知妆容/服装

SessionToken.description: 本项目游客会话令牌，不是供应商密钥

attachment_anchors.description: Category-specific source coordinates. lower_body: both hips/knees/ankles; headwear: ears; dress/skirt/shorts: hips and hem. Hem is a garment edge control, not an inferred anatomical landmark. Dress additionally requires torso anchors; other non-upper categories use null torso anchors.

hem_ratio.description: Required for dress/skirt/shorts previews: 0..1 interpolates current hip to knee; 1..2 knee to ankle. Shorts must be <=1. Garment-specific initial calibration, not body measurement.

PreviewImage.description: Upper body uses torso anchors; dress adds hips/hem and hem_ratio. Skirt/shorts use hips/hem and hem_ratio with null torso anchors. Selection excludes dress with upper/lower garments and allows only one of pants/skirt/shorts. Headwear is independent. Garment and asset categories must agree.

cover_url.description: Absolute HTTP(S), no userinfo or fragment. Media requests never inherit SessionToken. .invalid examples are not playable.

playback_url.description: Absolute HTTP(S), no userinfo or fragment. Media requests never inherit SessionToken. .invalid examples are not playable.

VideoMatch.description: Metadata sources require their request context resource id; user/model sources require null. Model semantics are a reserved source, not currently implemented.

VideoRecommendation.description: Only on-shelf, playable-authorized or explicitly synthetic candidates. Each match must equal a video tag and be supported by actual request context.

VideoRecommendationList.description: Unique video ids; len(items)=min(requested_limit,available_count). available_count counts eligible unique relevant candidates before truncation. Empty context yields zero; never pad with unrelated/repeated videos.
